verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes a public pricing page that covers Pro Search, search-context levels and Agent API tool usage, and its self-serve flow (API key in under 3 minutes, credit-based spend tiers) means no sales contact is needed. However, the evidence never shows actual per-request, per-token or per-credit dollar figures, so pricing clarity is implied rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: concrete per-request/per-token price figures, a per-model price table, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
